mapper.update: MERGE INTO T_ATM_UNIT_STATUS t USING ( SELECT #{termGroupId,jdbcType=CHAR} AS TERM_GROUP_ID, #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TERM_ID, #{deviceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS DEVICE_ID, #{agentType,jdbcType=CHAR} AS AGENT_TYPE FROM DUAL ) s ON ( t.TERM_GROUP_ID = s.TERM_GROUP_ID AND t.TERM_ID = s.TERM_ID AND t.DEVICE_ID = s.DEVICE_ID AND t.AGENT_TYPE = s.AGENT_TYPE ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.LOGICAL_SERVICE = #{logicalService,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.STATUS = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.FAULT_FLAG = #{faultFlag,jdbcType=CHAR}, t.JNL_DATE = #{jnlDate,jdbcType=CHAR}, t.JNL_TIME = #{jnlTime,jdbcType=CHAR}, t.SP_VERSION = #{spVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.EP_VERSION = #{epVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, DEVICE_ID, AGENT_TYPE, LOGICAL_SERVICE, STATUS, FAULT_FLAG, JNL_DATE, JNL_TIME, SP_VERSION, EP_VERSION, UPD_DT ) VALUES ( #{termGroupId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{agentType,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{logicalService,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{faultFlag,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{jnlDate,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{jnlTime,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{spVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{epVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
